company.title: Company
company.description: Who your company is inside the workspace and how it keeps time. The name and description travel with every profile, document and export; the working week drives calendars, time-off balances and every date the app calculates for you.

logo.title: Logo
logo.shown: Shown in the sidebar and at the top of the org chart.

roles.title: Roles and permissions
roles.description: Manage access by defining roles and their permissions. Use the table below to review, search and navigate to specific roles.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Everything that has happened in this company — who did it, when, and what changed. The list is read-only; open a row to see the details behind it.

attributes.title: Person information
attributes.description: Every field a person has. Custom fields are the ones your company defines — grouped into sections, with their own types, validation and sensitivity. System fields are built in and read-only: their values come from their own modules, and who may see them is set in Roles → Field access.

documents.title: Document categories
documents.description: Labels for the documents on a person's profile. Anyone who can see documents can pick a category when uploading; managing the list itself stays here.
